decisions.reason: As a still-recent extension of the core cardboard display business using existing capabilities in a growing market, it remains a low-cost option to keep open absent any clear negative signal.

Because the online customer portal is relatively distant from the firm's established physical display offer and likely requires continuing IT and security resources, the firm would be inclined to abandon it if traction has not become evident quickly.

The award-winning packaging display solution has generated a strong positive signal while building directly on the firm's core competencies, so its option value is high and the case for withdrawal is very weak.

This quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is close to the established offer and inexpensive to continue offering, so management would keep the option open while market acceptance becomes clearer.
The small cardboard counter display fits the firm's standard capabilities and customer base well, making it a low-risk, low-cost product to retain on the market.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is a close adjacency that supports the firm's broader 3D cardboard direction, so it is worth keeping unless later results show clearly weak demand.
